text:
incident-bot: Pager: high runtime queueing + elevated p95 latency for inference clusters in us-west1. triggered by sustained burst to /v1/generate.

alice: seeing this in dashboards — p50 ok, p95 token latency jumping to 1.2s/token and queue depth ~420. customers seeing 503s and timeouts. paging @ben @cory.

ben: on it. looking at autoscaler and in-flight counters. appears a hot model shard (gpt-open-1.2b-ht) got hammered, KV cache miss rate spiked.

cory: any correlation with recent rollout or routing changes?

alice: no deploys in last 30m. traffic spike looks organic (spike from a single tenant id=acct_57).

devon: support: one enterprise customer reported app errors ~10:07 PST. I'm drafting a customer message.

ben: quick mitigation plan: 1) reduce per-shard max_inflight from 100 -> 40 2) enable soft-shedding for legacy routes 3) bump tenant-specific rate limit to throttle the noisy tenant 4) lower request timeout from 90s -> 30s to free up worker slots.

alice: agree. add a temporary routing fallback to smaller quantized variant (gpt-open-1.2b-q4) for low-latency path.

cory: ok I can run the config change. doing per-shard change now. command I'm using:
```bash
# adjust runtime config via control-plane API
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://control.redwood.internal/v1/runtime/configs/shard/modify \
  -d '{"shard_id":"usw1-12","max_inflight":40,"soft_shed":true}'
```

ben: I'm toggling tenant throttle for acct_57: setting rate_limit 5r/s and burst 10.

alice: enable fallback routing for requests with seq_len>512 to gpt-open-1.2b-q4. Also activate prefix-KV caching for that shard.

cory: applied max_inflight change to shards: usw1-12, usw1-13. soft_shed=true. seeing in-flight drop ~30% and queue depth down to ~210. p95 token latency trending down.

devon: customer impacted list: acct_57 (noisy), acct_102 (minor errors), acct-enterprise-omega (reported timeouts). I'm sending an interim note to enterprise-omega: we detected transient routing congestion and have applied mitigations; ETA for full resolution ~30m.

ben: applying timeout change and route toggle now. command:
```json
PATCH /v1/routes/generate/parameters
{ "request_timeout_seconds": 30, "fallback_model": "gpt-open-1.2b-q4", "kv_cache": "enabled" }
```

ben: done. saw immediate drop in long-tail requests. shedding rate ~12% of inflight now (these get 429s).

alice: good. can we raise soft-shed threshold to accept more premium traffic? we should exempt enterprise-omega ACL.

cory: exempted enterprise-omega via tenant ACLs. their traffic now routed to dedicated pool (reserved-dedicated-3). no more 429s for them.

devon: sending an updated customer note: "We've routed your requests to a dedicated pool to maintain availability. No action required from your side; apologies for the disruption." :white_check_mark:

alice: great. next: follow-up postmortem items — investigate why KV cache miss spiked, consider autoscaler hysteresis, and add a tenant-aware surge-protector so single tenants can't starve model shards.

ben: logging the mitigation steps and metrics snapshot. will open an incident ticket with timeline and play-by-play.

cory: handing off to night oncall @ben2 in 40m. ben, please include shard IDs, change commands, and tenant throttles in the handoff note.

ben: ack handoff. I'll stay on for 10m to confirm stability then sign off.

incident-bot: Incident annotated: severity=sev2, mitigations=shard_max_inflight_reduced, soft_shedding_on, tenant_rate_limit_applied, route_fallback_enabled.

alice: closing the pager for now — queue depth down to <60, p95 back to baseline. will schedule follow-up eval. :thumbsup:
